title: Backend Manager
description: What You'll Do Build and scale systems that run around the clock at high throughput and low latency. Own features end to end, from first design to production rollout. Engineer for resilience: prevent failures, and recover fast when they happen anyway. Ship clean, well-tested code and hold a high bar for what goes live. Grow the engineers around you through mentorship and candid feedback. What You'll Bring Advanced experience with a modern, type-safe backend language. We're on .NET, but a strong engineer switches platforms quickly. Real competence in async and concurrent programming: thread pool behavior, concurrency primitives, and diagnosing deadlocks and sync-over-async mistakes. Hands-on work with layered, domain-oriented design (Clean/Hexagonal, DDD, Vertical Slices). You know where a business rule belongs and how an invariant is protected. CQRS and mediator/pipeline patterns, plus the judgment to draw module boundaries in a modular monolith or a microservice setup. Depth in relational databases: query plans, indexing strategy, transactions and isolation levels, locking and race conditions. A solid grasp of consistency models and their trade-offs, and designing for correctness with idempotency and compensating actions. The discipline to find bottlenecks by measuring — profiling, benchmarking, query analysis — rather than guessing. An eye for N+1 queries, unnecessary materialization, and excessive allocation while reading code. Sound HTTP/REST design: versioning, input validation, a meaningful error model. Strong Pluses Event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar) with partitioning, consumer groups, and idempotent consumers · Outbox/Inbox and sagas Distributed caching and invalidation strategies (Redis, Hazelcast) Real-time streaming (WebSocket, gRPC, SSE) and backpressure FIX protocol or exchange and liquidity provider APIs Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK) Background job infrastructure (Hangfire, Quartz) Progressive legacy migration (strangler-fig) Crypto exchange or fintech experience is a significant advantage.

title: Full Stack Developer - EatBetter - İzmir
description: At EatBetter our goal is to build AI-first, new-age, unique mobile experiences that help millions of people learn nutrition and improve their eating habits easily and sustainably. We have a track record of growing to 100K+ users in Turkey at a rapid pace. Now we are focusing on expanding EatBetter globally. We offer you an opportunity to make a huge, global impact in the lives of millions of users through our products. At EatBetter, we believe passion drives success. Growth is only possible by loving what you do, at scale. Some of your responsibilities Build and ship high-quality features across web and mobile backends, end-to-end Develop scalable APIs and services; collaborate with mobile engineers and data teams Design and operate core backend infrastructure: caching (Redis), queues/jobs, and background workers Work on frontend surfaces when needed (admin panels, growth dashboards, landing pages) Own architecture decisions, performance, reliability, and security best practices Improve reliability and delivery: monitoring/alerting, incident response, and CI/CD pipelines Collaborate closely with product and design to deliver great UX with fast iteration cycles Instrument analytics and events to support growth experiments and product insights Write clean, testable code; contribute to code reviews, CI/CD, and engineering standards What we look for 3+ years of experience as a full stack developer (or strong proof of end-to-end ownership in shipped products) Strong fundamentals in backend development (APIs, databases, authentication, caching) Hands-on experience with Redis and relational databases (PostgreSQL), including performance tuning basics Solid frontend skills (React, React Native) and an eye for UX quality Experience with modern TypeScript/Node.js (or you can ramp up quickly) Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, observability, and deployment workflows (Docker, CI/CD) Product-minded: you understand how engineering choices impact user experience and growth Excellent spoken and written English Bonus: experience with mobile app ecosystems, subscriptions/payments, or data pipelines The perks and benefits of working with us We would like you to focus on what you do best, we take care of the rest. Daily essentials: We provide commuting and meal support to make your workday easier. A brand new MacBook , new monitor and tools dedicated for you to have a productive workspace. Wellbeing: We provide supplementary private health insurance , giving you access to quality care at leading hospitals and clinics in İzmir and across Turkey. A unique and top-notch office: At the heart of Izmir, at our IzQ Office you’ll have the best-located workplace. Strong company culture: Our approach is built on open 100% transparent communication and teamwork Office fuel: We offer the best espresso in town—unlimited. EatBetter memberships: Lifetime Premium access to the EatBetter apps and memberships and products. Learning & development: We support your continuous learning with fast-growing startup dynamics and hands-on, unlimited growth experience. Birthday perks: To celebrate you, we offer a dedicated birthday leave for you to enjoy your best day with your loved ones, wherever you want. The Recruiting Process At EatBetter, we value transparency and efficiency. Here’s a glimpse into our streamlined recruitment process: Application Submission : Apply by submitting your CV, LinkedIn profile, or a brief introduction about yourself. People & Culture Interview : Engage in a conversation with our People & Culture team to discuss your background, aspirations, and how we align with each other’s goals. If your profile matches our needs, we will get in touch with you at this stage. Case Study Assignment : Showcase your skills through a practical task related to the role. Technical Interview : Meet with your potential team lead for an in-depth, live review of your case study and technical expertise and skills. Welcome Aboard! : If all goes well, we’re excited to extend an offer and welcome you to the team. If growing a startup from Turkey that will become a huge global success in the very competitive health & fitness market excites you, EatBetter is just the right next step to join us and achieve this success together.
